the keys-set delegation (subcards.rb:57-59 respond_to_missing?) has no port counterpart because there is no collection object to delegate from; the entry iteration (subcards.rb:77-79 each_card) and the keyed iteration (subcards.rb:83-88 each_with_key) collapse into the engine's Object.entries walk over the posted tree; the fetch-or-new per key (subcards.rb:90-92 fetch_subcard) collapses into fetchByName plus the create path per entry; the key normalization and name absolutization (subcards.rb:96-110 subcard_key, absolutize_subcard_name) collapse into the engine's leading-plus parse against the main name; the three-way entry dispatch (subcards/add.rb:32-38 add), the hash form (add.rb:40-46 add_hash), the joint-prepend form (add.rb:48-51 add_child), the staged constructions (add.rb:54-76 new_by_card, new_by_attributes, initialize_by_attributes) and the many-entry dispatch (add.rb:81-93 multi_add) collapse into the posted field shape, the tree walk, subcardCreateInput's superActionId chain and blankNewSubcard's blank skip; the staged-content reader (subcards/all.rb:24-26 subcard_content) collapses into the entry's content field; the drop-by-field form (subcards/all.rb:61-63 drop_field) and the staged-removal family (subcards/remove.rb:5-40 remove_child, remove, clear, clear_key, deep_clear) have no port counterpart because the port has no staged collection to edit - a posted trash arm routes to trashInWriter, which is the deck's own deletion semantics; and the args extraction (subcards/args.rb:5-39 extract_subcard_args!, safe_subcard_args, extract_explicit_fields, extract_implicit_fields) collapses into the request parser's subcardTree and plus-key grammar (write-routes.ts:449-456).
